_about: Deal-size tiers: the deal ARR (USD) decides how many NEW IDEAS the agent adds on top of the agreed use cases — the proposed additions from its research, and how ambitious they are. It does NOT limit the configuration of the agreed demo (objects, fields, processes, AI…): build what the script needs. Bounds: min inclusive, max exclusive. Edit the numbers here — validate_spec.py and the documents read this file.

tiers.label: OOTB — keep it simple
tiers.intent: Few, light ideas: quick wins with standard functionality (a widget, a rule, a folder). No new use cases, no flow redesign.

tiers.label: Medium impact
tiers.intent: Moderate ideas: small and medium additions that sharpen the story; moderate flow improvements.

tiers.label: High impact
tiers.intent: Active ideas: competitive differentiators, smarter steps, larger additions where the research supports them.

tiers.label: Extremely high impact
tiers.intent: Bold ideas: re-think the flow, propose new use cases, AI agents, end-to-end scenarios — at least one re-designed flow.
